isolation_intervention.operation: At the first type-$8D pre-handler sample, clear every non-type-$8D enemy on every frame and clear the enemy-bullet pool once.
isolation_intervention.valid_for: Attributing type-$8D-family animation, art, and later enemy-bullet count rises.
isolation_intervention.invalid_for: Pacing, density, difficulty, and unaided lifetime.

death_intervention.operation: After 200 isolated lifecycle frames, force the P1-hit bit and negative HP on two successive pre-handler samples.
death_intervention.stage1_observed: Enemy remains live with sub-record flag byte 1 bit 7 set and fixed art $193B4C.
death_intervention.stage2_observed: The next forced negative hit frees the slot one sampled logic frame later.
death_intervention.valid_for: Reachability and ordering of the two-stage damage/death lifecycle.
death_intervention.invalid_for: Natural damage, kill time, score values, sound identity, and unaided survival.

bounded_attempts.first_run: 13200 frames with auto-fire disabled reached no stage-2 enemies; this is a runner-input correction, not negative type-$8D evidence.
bounded_attempts.corrected_run: 13400 frames with the existing labelled auto-fire intervention reached six type-$8D occurrences.

limitations: The static ROM inventory has 37 type-$8D records. This controlled run reaches the first six. Remaining occurrences are static-minus-dynamic, never guessed.
